questions.question: How did the authors use abstract-level relevance scores when screening the literature for the Nipah inhibitor knowledgebase?

options.A: Papers with confirmed inhibitor information scored 10, uncertain relevance 5, peptide inhibitors 4, and unrelated papers 0; scores 10, 5, and 4 proceeded
options.B: Only papers scoring 10 were retained, while peptide inhibitors scored 0
options.C: Papers were scored by IC50, with 5 nM as the inclusion cutoff
options.D: All 838 papers were curated without relevance scoring

questions.rationale: The curation pipeline began with a keyword search, then manually curated the relevance-scored subset.
questions.evidence_quote: At the time of curation this keyword listed 838 papers which were considered for data-mining. This step was followed by a scoring system wherein papers that had confirmed information regarding the inhibitors against Nipah virus in their abstracts were assigned a score of '10', those that may or may not have information regarding the same were given a score of '5', those with information on peptides used as inhibitors were assigned a score of '4' and rest with no relevant information were given a score of '0'. Papers with score values of 10, 5 and 4 were considered for further study

questions.question: What distinction did the authors make between total knowledgebase entries and the small-molecule set used for most prioritization?

options.A: NVIK had 182 entries; 125 were focus entries, of which 98 were unique small-molecule inhibitors
options.B: NVIK had 125 entries, all unique small molecules, and 182 assay values
options.C: NVIK had 98 entries total, of which 70 were peptides
options.D: NVIK had 182 unique small molecules and 125 non-small-molecule records

questions.rationale: The entry count includes peptides and incomplete records; the focused small-molecule subset was smaller and included multiple assays for some compounds.
questions.evidence_quote: At present, NVIK has 182 entries. The focus of the study was to evaluate small molecule inhibitors which were 125 entries as the rest 57 were either peptide or did not have complete information. Of these 125 entries, 98 are unique nipah inhibitors as for a few compounds more than one assay has been curated from the literature.

questions.question: How many small-molecule entries had measurable IC50/EC50 values, and what range did those values span?

options.A: 70 had values, spanning 0.47 nM to 7,562,710 nM
options.D: 182 had values, spanning 4.7 nM to 75,627 nM

questions.rationale: The paper reports activity values for only 70 of 98 unique small molecules and gives the range specifically for the 125-entry small-molecule subset.
questions.evidence_quote: Of these, EC50/IC50 values could be obtained for 70 compounds and structures are available for all 98 inhibitors. The EC50/IC50 values range from 0.25 nM to 7562710 nM for 182 entries and 0.47 nM to 7562710 nM for 125 small molecule entries.

questions.question: What was the purpose of scoring assay robustness separately from computed drug-likeness?

options.A: To prioritize inhibitors based on the reliability of the experiments that identified them, independent of physicochemical filters
options.B: To infer clinical efficacy directly from molecular weight
options.C: To replace the IC50/EC50 measurements with docking scores
options.D: To determine whether compounds were structurally similar to NiV proteins

questions.rationale: The combined-evidence approach deliberately treats assay quality as a separate prioritization axis from chemical properties.
questions.evidence_quote: Our two pronged strategy comprised of (i) prioritization of NVIs based on the robustness of the assays which were used to identify them and (ii) estimation of several drug likeness parameters for the NVIs.

questions.question: Which computational filters and descriptor tools were used to characterize the inhibitor library?

options.A: PaDEL calculated 1,875 descriptors; DruLito screened eight drug-likeness rules and PAINS was used for interference/toxicity profiling
options.B: Cytoscape calculated eight descriptors and a single Lipinski rule served as the only filter
options.C: NNeib calculated 1,875 IC50 values, while PAINS selected the assay format
options.D: DruLito generated 90 clusters and PaDEL measured viral replication

questions.rationale: Descriptor calculation, drug-likeness screening, and PAINS filtering were complementary analyses in the workflow.
questions.evidence_quote: A total of 1875 descriptors were calculated using PaDel software [30] .

questions.question: How stringent was the reported DruLito result for the 91 compounds assessed?

options.A: Only two passed all filters other than the CMC filter
options.B: All 91 passed every filter, including CMC
options.D: None passed any filter, including Lipinski's rule

questions.rationale: The study reports very few compounds clearing the collection of drug-likeness screens.
questions.evidence_quote: As can be seen from Figure 4 only two of 91 compounds passed all filters other than CMC filter.

questions.question: What evidence supported the claim that the curated inhibitors occupy diverse chemical space?

options.A: The 98 inhibitors formed many small clusters, mostly singletons, under a 0.15 dissimilarity threshold
options.B: All inhibitors belonged to one cluster with identical scaffolds
options.C: The inhibitors were divided into three clusters using a 0.5 Tanimoto threshold
options.D: The dataset contained only 14 compounds and no structural information

questions.rationale: The clustering analysis used a dissimilarity threshold of 0.15 and found predominantly singleton clusters, indicating diversity.
questions.evidence_quote: The clusters of NVIs have been obtained using Jarp (version 6.0.2) (https://docs.chemaxon.com/display/docs/Jarvis-Patrick+clustering). which is based on the dissimilarity threshold (1-Tanimoto coefficient). A threshold of 0.15 is used as the dissimilarity coefficient.

questions.question: What scale of structural overlap with existing medicines did the similarity analysis identify?

options.A: Thirty-four NVIs were similar to 76 FDA-approved drugs
options.B: Seventy-six NVIs were identical to 34 approved drugs
options.C: All 98 NVIs were structurally identical to FDA-approved drugs
options.D: Only three NVIs had any similarity to antiviral molecules

questions.rationale: The analysis identifies a subset with approved-drug neighbors that may aid repurposing or safety triage.
questions.evidence_quote: In total, there are 34 NVIs similar to 76 FDA approved drugsf.

questions.question: Among NVIC0025, NVIC0032, and NVIC0048, which compound combined the strongest reported activity with drug-property overlap?

options.A: NVIC0032 had better activity, while NVIC0048 overlapped most broadly with the six physicochemical ranges
options.B: NVIC0048 had the best activity and no overlap with drug-property ranges
options.C: NVIC0025 alone passed all filters and was more active than the other two
options.D: All three had identical activity and physicochemical profiles

questions.rationale: The authors distinguish highest overlap from strongest activity rather than treating one candidate as best on every criterion.
questions.evidence_quote: Of the three compounds shortlisted NVIC0048 displayed a high degree of overlap with all six physicochemical parameter ranges. However NVIC0032 (9167 (2,2,2-trifluoro-N-[3-(Nnaphthylcarbamoyl) (4,5,6,7-tetrahydrobenzo[β] exhibits better activity among the three and has considerable overlap with the physicochemical properties of FDA approved drugs.

questions.question: What limitation does the paper's prioritization strategy leave unresolved about candidate drugs?

options.A: It ranks literature-reported inhibitors by assay robustness and computed properties but does not demonstrate clinical efficacy
options.B: It proves all prioritized compounds are safe and effective in human patients
options.C: It excludes assay quality and relies only on animal pharmacokinetics
options.D: It uses no measured inhibitor activities or chemical structures

questions.rationale: The work is a knowledgebase and prioritization exercise; the evidence is in vitro literature data and computed filters, not clinical trials.
questions.evidence_quote: Despite being a lethal pathogen there is not a single drug under clinical trial against this virus.
